title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Dat -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑energy NYC opener with Playin' → Crazy Fingers shines, captured on a clean soundboard tape.
ai_review.review: The September 21 1982 show bursts open with the classic Playin' into an incendiary Crazy Fingers, plus a funky West LA Fadeaway and a soaring High Time; the performance is praised for its energy and solid playing throughout. The Miller‑taped soundboard source delivers clear, well‑balanced audio that fans describe as nice and listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the sound quality; strong show performance weighted heavily with a good‑quality soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced sound; reviewers repeatedly note 'nice sound' and have no complaints about dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Opener Playin' into Crazy Fingers sets a high‑octane tone, followed by West LA Fadeaway and High Time, maintaining momentum through the set; overall flow described as solid and exciting.
